messages:
sam_csm: NimbleRx asked if we can move 5 seats from the beta waitlist to active. They say NDA is signed but they need SOC2 excerpt before security sign-off.

maria_success: I saw the signed NDA in the portal. SOC2 ask is on legal side — @chris_pm can you confirm if we can share the standard SOC2 summary PDF this week?

chris_pm: Yep, I can send the SOC2 summary. Need to check if the customer needs redacted org details. If not, we can share today. @jasmin_eng can we prioritize a short enablement session for the 5 seats next Tue?

jasmin_eng: Tue works for a 30m walkthru. I can do 10–10:30 PT. Will prepare quick runbook and sample prompts.

sam_csm: Awesome. Also flagging potential renewal risk if onboarding delays > 2 weeks — NimbleRx has tight timelines. I'll propose a two-week onboarding SLA in the pilot agreement.

maria_success: Good call. Also let's capture feedback ask: product requested success metrics and sample prompts to evaluate latency/cost. I'll send a short intake form.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: create calendar event with attendees: sam_csm, jasmin_eng, 2x NimbleRx engineers. Use template 'beta-onboard-30'.

sam_csm: Putting tentative invite now. @chris_pm once SOC2 excerpt is ready, drop it in the thread and I'll attach to the invite.

chris_pm: Uploaded SOC2_summary_redacted.pdf to secure-share: https://files.redwood.com/soc2/NimbleRx

sam_csm: Thanks. @maria_success can you send the intake form to NimbleRx and include the two evaluation prompts suggested by product? Then we'll close the loop.

maria_success: Done — form sent. Included metrics: end-to-end latency at 95th pct, token-unit cost target, quality rubric.

jasmin_eng: Prep notes done. Quick runbook snippet:
```
1) API key & network test
2) example prompt set
3) run 50 traces, capture p50/p95 latency
4) export logs to CSV
```

sam_csm: Perfect. Reopening if anything blocks. I'll mark this thread 'priority' in the tracker. :rocket:
